newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's HACTL throughput up 21.1 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: HK's HACTL throughput up 21.1 pct in January.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Tuesday its throughput in January rose 21.1 percent to 121,321 tonnes compared with the same month in 1996.
It said in a statement that the rise was encouraging, although it might distort figures in the first quarter as it coincided with the Lunar New Year.
"Even making allowances for this, January's increase is encouragingly ahead of our forecasts," said managing director Anthony Charter in the statement.
Exports also climbed 25.8 percent in January over the same month last year to 55,868 tonnes while imports rose 16 percent to 51,336 tonnes and transhipment goods leapt 22.7 percent to 14,117 tonnes.
HACTL also said it improved its reliability record.
Of 209,608 consignments handled in January, only seven were mishandled, or one in 29,944, from an average of one in every 28,178 during 1996.
A record 1,489,148 tonnes of air cargo and 26,259 tonnes of courier traffic passed through its Kai Tak terminal complex in 1996, it said.

The group is 25 percent held by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, 20 percent by Swire Pacific Ltd, 12.5 percent by Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, 12.5 percent by Hutchinson Whampoa Ltd and 10 percent each by CITIC Pacific Ltd, China National Aviation Corp and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
